_meta.title: UK gender pay gap reports, every employer, 2017/18 to 2026/27
_meta.what: One point per employer that has ever published a gender pay gap report on the UK government Gender Pay Gap service. Employers in Great Britain with 250 or more staff must report every year; some smaller employers report voluntarily and are included too. No employer is filtered out. Each point uses the employer's latest report for its position and headline figures, and "history" holds every year it reported. The gap figures are percentages: how much lower women's hourly pay (or bonus pay) is than men's across the whole employer, using the median (middle earner) or the mean (average). A positive number means women are paid less; a negative number means women are paid more. It compares all women with all men in the organisation, not equal pay for the same job. "quartiles" splits staff into four equal pay bands (lowest to top) and gives the % men and % women in each, as [male, female]. "male_bonus_pct"/"female_bonus_pct" are the % of men and of women who got a bonus. "late" = submitted after the deadline (the 2019/20 file has no late flags: enforcement was suspended that year because of Covid-19). The 2026/27 year is still open: its file holds only early reports submitted so far.
_meta.year_convention: "year" is the start of the reporting year as the service names it: 2024 = the "2024 to 2025 reporting year" (the CSV DueDate for that year is 31 March 2025 for public bodies or 5 April 2025 for others).
_meta.source: UK Government Equalities Office, Gender Pay Gap Service (gender-pay-gap.service.gov.uk), yearly "Download all data by reporting year" CSV files
_meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
_meta.attribution_note: The service footer says "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated"; it gives no custom wording, so the OGL v3.0 default attribution statement is used. Geocoding: postcodes.io (ONS Postcode Directory, OGL; Royal Mail/OS data: Contains OS data (c) Crown copyright and database right; Contains Royal Mail data (c) Royal Mail copyright and database right; Contains National Statistics data (c) Crown copyright and database right).
_meta.fields: lat/lon = postcode centroid (precision "postcode"); geocode_from = latest | earlier_year | corrected_O_to_0 (letter O typed for zero in the published postcode) | terminated (postcode no longer live, last known centroid) | none; same_postcode = number of employers in this file placed on the same postcode (positions are not moved); area = postcode + local authority district; size = employer's own staff-size band; sic = SIC codes as published (comma separated); link = employer's own web page about its gap; due = report deadline; history[] = every reporting year: year, the four gap figures, late, and name when it differed from the latest report (full per-year columns are in the source CSVs); current_name appears only when the service's current name differs. Personal names (ResponsiblePerson) and street addresses are left out.
